tmua-2017-p1-q1.summary: Given $\frac{dy}{dx}=3x^2-\frac{2-3x}{x^3}$ for $x\ne0$ and $y=5$ when $x=1$, find $y$ in terms of $x$.
tmua-2017-p1-q1.summaryZh: 已知 $x\ne0$ 时 $\frac{dy}{dx}=3x^2-\frac{2-3x}{x^3}$，且 $x=1$ 时 $y=5$，求 $y$ 关于 $x$ 的表达式。

methods.title: Integrate and use the initial value
steps: Rewrite the derivative as $3x^2-2x^{-3}+3x^{-2}$. Term-by-term integration gives $y=x^3+x^{-2}-3x^{-1}+C$.
At $x=1$, the nonconstant part equals $1+1-3=-1$. Since $y=5$, $C=6$, giving option C on the connected branch $x>0$.

Strictly, the differential equation is undefined at $x=0$, so the initial value does not determine the integration constant on $x<0$. The multiple-choice question uses the usual school-level convention that one displayed formula is required on both parts of the stated domain.
stepsZh: 当 $x=1$ 时，非恒定部分为 $1+1-3=-1$。由 $y=5$ 得 $C=6$，所以在包含初值的连通区间 $x>0$ 上选 C。
严格来说，微分方程在 $x=0$ 处无定义，初值不能决定 $x<0$ 分支的积分常数。本选择题采用学校数学中的通常约定：在所给定义域两部分使用同一个显示公式。

methods.title: Expand into powers before differentiating
methods.titleZh: 先展开成幂函数再求导
steps: Substitution of $x=1$ gives $24-24+5=5$.

tmua-2017-p1-q3.summary: The line $l$ is $y=6-2x$. A second line is perpendicular to $l$ and passes through $(-6,0)$. Find the area enclosed by the two lines and the $x$-axis.
tmua-2017-p1-q3.summaryZh: 直线 $l$ 的方程为 $y=6-2x$。另一条直线与 $l$ 垂直并经过 $(-6,0)$。求两直线与 $x$ 轴围成区域的面积。

methods.title: Find the triangle's base and height
steps: $l$ meets the $x$-axis at $(3,0)$. The perpendicular line has slope $1/2$ and equation $y=\tfrac12(x+6)$.
Solving $6-2x=\tfrac12x+3$ gives the intersection height $y=18/5$.
The base on the $x$-axis has length $3-(-6)=9$, so the area is $\tfrac12\cdot9\cdot18/5=81/5=16\tfrac15$.
stepsZh: $l$ 与 $x$ 轴交于 $(3,0)$。垂线斜率为 $1/2$，方程为 $y=\tfrac12(x+6)$。
$x$ 轴上的底长为 $3-(-6)=9$，故面积为 $\tfrac12\cdot9\cdot18/5=81/5=16\tfrac15$。

tmua-2017-p1-q4.summary: The polynomial $(3x^2+8x-3)(px-1)$ leaves remainder $24$ when divided by $x+1$. Find $p$.

methods.title: Apply the remainder theorem without expanding
methods.titleZh: 不展开，直接使用余数定理
steps: If $F(x)=(3x^2+8x-3)(px-1)$, division by $x+1$ leaves remainder $F(-1)$.

tmua-2017-p1-q5.summary: Let $S$ be the set of real $x$ satisfying both $x^2-8x+12<0$ and $2x+1>9$. Express $S$ as one quadratic inequality.
tmua-2017-p1-q5.summaryZh: 设 $S$ 为同时满足 $x^2-8x+12<0$ 与 $2x+1>9$ 的实数 $x$ 的集合，把 $S$ 表示为一个二次不等式。

methods.title: Intersect intervals and rebuild a quadratic
methods.titleZh: 先求交集，再构造二次不等式
steps: Factor the first inequality: $(x-2)(x-6)<0$, so $2<x<6$. The second gives $x>4$.
Their intersection is $4<x<6$, which is exactly $(x-4)(x-6)<0$, or $x^2-10x+24<0$.
stepsZh: 第一式因式分解为 $(x-2)(x-6)<0$，故 $2<x<6$；第二式给出 $x>4$。

tmua-2017-p1-q6.summary: A tangent to $x^2+y^2=144$ passes through $(20,0)$ and crosses the positive $y$-axis. Find its $y$-intercept.
tmua-2017-p1-q6.summaryZh: 圆 $x^2+y^2=144$ 的一条切线经过 $(20,0)$ 并与 $y$ 轴正半轴相交，求其纵截距。

methods.title: Use the right-triangle similarity
steps: Let the external point be $R=(20,0)$ and the tangency point be $Q$. Since the radius is perpendicular to the tangent, $OQ=12$ and $OR=20$ give $QR=16$.
If the tangent meets the $y$-axis at $P=(0,k)$, the standard altitude similarity in right triangle $POR$ gives $PO/OQ=OR/QR$.
stepsZh: 设外点为 $R=(20,0)$、切点为 $Q$。半径垂直切线，且 $OQ=12,OR=20$，故 $QR=16$。
若切线与 $y$ 轴交于 $P=(0,k)$，直角三角形 $POR$ 中的相似关系给出 $PO/OQ=OR/QR$。

methods.title: Force a repeated intersection
steps: Write the tangent through $(20,0)$ as $y=m(x-20)$. Substitution in the circle gives $(m^2+1)x^2-40m^2x+400m^2-144=0$.
Tangency requires discriminant zero, giving $64m^2=36$. The positive $y$-intercept requires $m=-3/4$.
stepsZh: 相切要求判别式为零，化简得 $64m^2=36$。纵截距为正，因此 $m=-3/4$。

tmua-2017-p1-q7.summary: The first three terms of an arithmetic progression are $p,q,p^2$, where $p<0$. The first three terms of a geometric progression are $p,p^2,q$. Find the sum of the first ten arithmetic terms.
tmua-2017-p1-q7.summaryZh: 某等差数列前三项为 $p,q,p^2$，其中 $p<0$；某等比数列前三项为 $p,p^2,q$。求该等差数列前十项之和。

methods.title: Link the two progressions
steps: The geometric ratio is $p$, so $q=p^3$. If the arithmetic difference is $d$, then $p^3=p+d$ and $p^2=p+2d$.
Eliminating $d$ gives $p(2p+1)(p-1)=0$. Since $p<0$, $p=-1/2$, and then $d=p^3-p=3/8$.
stepsZh: 等比数列的公比为 $p$，故 $q=p^3$。设等差数列公差为 $d$，则 $p^3=p+d$、$p^2=p+2d$。

tmua-2017-p1-q8.summary: Find all $x$ in $[0,\pi]$ satisfying $(1-2\sin x)\cos x\ge0$.
tmua-2017-p1-q8.summaryZh: 求区间 $[0,\pi]$ 内满足 $(1-2\sin x)\cos x\ge0$ 的所有 $x$。

methods.title: Make a sign chart for both factors
methods.titleZh: 分别作两因子的符号表
steps: $1-2\sin x$ is nonnegative on $[0,\pi/6]\cup[5\pi/6,\pi]$ and nonpositive between those intervals.
$\cos x$ is nonnegative on $[0,\pi/2]$ and nonpositive on $[\pi/2,\pi]$.
The factors have the same sign on $[0,\pi/6]$ and $[\pi/2,5\pi/6]$. Endpoints are included because equality is allowed.
stepsZh: $1-2\sin x$ 在 $[0,\pi/6]\cup[5\pi/6,\pi]$ 上非负，在中间区间非正。
$\cos x$ 在 $[0,\pi/2]$ 上非负，在 $[\pi/2,\pi]$ 上非正。
两因子同号的区间为 $[0,\pi/6]$ 与 $[\pi/2,5\pi/6]$。因允许等号，端点均保留。

tmua-2017-p1-q9.summary: A regular hexagon is inscribed in the circle $x^2+y^2-18x-22y+178=0$. Find the area of the hexagon.
tmua-2017-p1-q9.summaryZh: 正六边形内接于圆 $x^2+y^2-18x-22y+178=0$，求六边形面积。

methods.title: Complete the square and split the hexagon
steps: Completing squares gives $(x-9)^2+(y-11)^2=24$, so the squared radius is $r^2=24$.
The hexagon is six equilateral triangles of side $r$. Each has area $\frac{\sqrt3}{4}r^2=6\sqrt3$.
Therefore the hexagon has area $36\sqrt3$.
stepsZh: 正六边形可分成六个边长为 $r$ 的正三角形，每个面积为 $\frac{\sqrt3}{4}r^2=6\sqrt3$。

tmua-2017-p1-q10.summary: Let $f(x)=p^3-6p^2x+3px^2-x^3$, where $p$ is real. The normal to $y=f(x)$ at $x=-1$ has gradient $M$. Find the greatest possible $M$.
tmua-2017-p1-q10.summaryZh: 设 $f(x)=p^3-6p^2x+3px^2-x^3$，其中 $p$ 为实数。曲线在 $x=-1$ 处法线斜率为 $M$，求 $M$ 的最大值。

methods.title: Minimise the tangent-gradient denominator
methods.titleZh: 最小化法线斜率的分母
steps: $f'(x)=-6p^2+6px-3x^2$, so at $x=-1$ the tangent gradient is $-3(2p^2+2p+1)$.
The normal gradient is $M=1/[3(2p^2+2p+1)]$.
Since $2p^2+2p+1=2(p+1/2)^2+1/2$, its minimum is $1/2$, giving $M_{\max}=2/3$.

tmua-2017-p1-q11.summary: The sequence satisfies $x_1=7$ and $x_{n+1}=\frac{23x_n-53}{5x_n+1}$. Its first three terms are $7,3,1$. Find $x_{100}$.

methods.title: Detect the four-term cycle
steps: Continuing the recurrence gives $x_4=(23-53)/6=-5$ and $x_5=(-115-53)/(-24)=7$.
The deterministic recurrence therefore repeats $7,3,1,-5$ with period four.
Since $100$ is divisible by $4$, $x_{100}$ is the fourth entry of the cycle, namely $-5$.
stepsZh: 递推式由当前项唯一决定下一项，因此 $7,3,1,-5$ 以四为周期重复。
因为 $100$ 能被 $4$ 整除，$x_{100}$ 是循环中的第四项，即 $-5$。

tmua-2017-p1-q12.summary: A polynomial $f$ is positive for every real $x$ and $\int_2^4 f(x)\,dx=A$. Determine $\int_0^2[f(x+2)+1]\,dx$.
tmua-2017-p1-q12.summaryZh: 多项式 $f$ 对所有实数 $x$ 均为正，且 $\int_2^4 f(x)\,dx=A$。求 $\int_0^2[f(x+2)+1]\,dx$。

methods.title: Translate the integral
steps: With $u=x+2$, $\int_0^2f(x+2)\,dx=\int_2^4f(u)\,du=A$.
Also $\int_0^2 1\,dx=2$, so the required value is $A+2$.

tmua-2017-p1-q13.summary: In $(a+bx)^5$, the coefficient of $x^4$ is eight times the coefficient of $x^2$. Given positive integers $a,b$, find the least possible $a+b$.
tmua-2017-p1-q13.summaryZh: 在 $(a+bx)^5$ 的展开式中，$x^4$ 的系数是 $x^2$ 系数的八倍。已知 $a,b$ 为正整数，求 $a+b$ 的最小值。

methods.title: Compare the two binomial coefficients
methods.titleZh: 比较两个二项式项的系数
steps: The $x^4$ coefficient is $5ab^4$, while the $x^2$ coefficient is $10a^3b^2$.
$5ab^4=8(10a^3b^2)$ reduces, since $a,b>0$, to $b^2=16a^2$, hence $b=4a$.
Thus $a+b=5a$, whose least positive value is $5$ at $(a,b)=(1,4)$.
stepsZh: 于是 $a+b=5a$，最小正整数值在 $(a,b)=(1,4)$ 时为 $5$。

tmua-2017-p1-q14.summary: The simultaneous equations $2^x+3\cdot2^y=3$ and $2^{2x}-9\cdot2^{2y}=6$ have solution $x=p,y=q$. Find $p-q$.

methods.title: Use a difference of squares
steps: Put $a=2^x$ and $b=2^y$. The equations are $a+3b=3$ and $(a+3b)(a-3b)=6$.
The first equation makes the second give $a-3b=2$. Solving yields $a=5/2$ and $b=1/6$.
stepsZh: 由第一式，第二式给出 $a-3b=2$。联立得 $a=5/2,b=1/6$。

tmua-2017-p1-q15.summary: Let $f(x)=-2x^2+10$. On $0\le x\le1$, compare trapezium-rule estimates for (1) $y=f(x)$, (2) $y=f(x+1)$, and (3) the graph of $y=f(x+1)$ reflected in $y=6$.
tmua-2017-p1-q15.summaryZh: 设 $f(x)=-2x^2+10$。在 $0\le x\le1$ 上，判断梯形法则对以下三条曲线所得估计是偏大还是偏小：(1) $y=f(x)$；(2) $y=f(x+1)$；(3) $y=f(x+1)$ 关于 $y=6$ 的对称图像。

methods.title: Read the sign of the second derivative
methods.titleZh: 利用二阶导数判断凹凸性
steps: $f''(x)=-4<0$, so $f$ is concave down and each chord lies below the curve: the trapezium rule underestimates (1).
Horizontal translation does not change the second derivative, so (2) is also underestimated.
Reflection in $y=6$ gives $y=12-f(x+1)$, whose second derivative is $4>0$. Its chords lie above the curve, so (3) is overestimated.
stepsZh: $f''(x)=-4<0$，故图像开口向下，弦在曲线下方，梯形法则对 (1) 低估。
水平平移不改变二阶导数，所以对 (2) 仍为低估。
关于 $y=6$ 对称后方程为 $y=12-f(x+1)$，二阶导数为 $4>0$，弦在曲线上方，故对 (3) 高估。

tmua-2017-p1-q16.summary: Let $f(x)=3x^2+12x+4$ and $g(x)=x^3+6x^2+9x-8$. Find all $x$ for which one function is increasing and the other decreasing, using non-strict derivative signs.
tmua-2017-p1-q16.summaryZh: 设 $f(x)=3x^2+12x+4$、$g(x)=x^3+6x^2+9x-8$。按导数非负表示递增、非正表示递减，求一增一减时所有 $x$。

methods.title: Compare derivative sign charts
methods.titleZh: 比较两个导数的符号表
steps: $f'(x)=6(x+2)$ changes sign at $-2$. Also $g'(x)=3(x+1)(x+3)$ is nonnegative outside $[-3,-1]$ and nonpositive inside.
$f'\le0,g'\ge0$ gives $x\le-3$. The opposite signs $f'\ge0,g'\le0$ give $-2\le x\le-1$.
Taking the union yields the stated set.
stepsZh: $f'\le0,g'\ge0$ 给出 $x\le-3$；反向符号 $f'\ge0,g'\le0$ 给出 $-2\le x\le-1$。

tmua-2017-p1-q17.summary: For positive integers $n$, define $F(n)=\frac1n\int_0^n(n-x)\,dx$ and $G(n)=\sum_{r=1}^nF(r)$. Find the least $n$ for which $G(n)>150$.
tmua-2017-p1-q17.summaryZh: 对正整数 $n$，定义 $F(n)=\frac1n\int_0^n(n-x)\,dx$、$G(n)=\sum_{r=1}^nF(r)$。求使 $G(n)>150$ 的最小 $n$。

methods.title: Evaluate the integral and sum
steps: $G(n)=\frac12\sum_{r=1}^nr=\frac14n(n+1)$.
Thus $G(n)>150$ means $n(n+1)>600$. Since $24\cdot25=600$ but $25\cdot26=650$, the least $n$ is $25$.

tmua-2017-p1-q18.summary: The graph $y=\log_{10}x$ is translated upward by $2$. This is equivalent to a horizontal stretch by factor $k$. Find $k$.
tmua-2017-p1-q18.summaryZh: 把 $y=\log_{10}x$ 的图像向上平移 $2$ 个单位，这等价于水平方向伸缩因子为 $k$ 的变换。求 $k$。

methods.title: Match the transformed function
steps: An upward translation gives $\log_{10}x+2$. A horizontal stretch by factor $k$ gives $\log_{10}(x/k)$.
Equating them for all $x>0$ gives $-\log_{10}k=2$, hence $k=10^{-2}=0.01$.
stepsZh: 向上平移得到 $\log_{10}x+2$；水平方向伸缩因子为 $k$ 后得到 $\log_{10}(x/k)$。

tmua-2017-p1-q19.summary: The solutions of $x^2+bx+c<0$ form $p<x<q$, where $c<0$. Find the solution interval of $x^2+bcx+c^3<0$.
tmua-2017-p1-q19.summaryZh: 不等式 $x^2+bx+c<0$ 的解集为 $p<x<q$，且 $c<0$。求 $x^2+bcx+c^3<0$ 的解区间。

methods.title: Scale the original inequality
steps: Divide the new inequality by $c^2>0$ to obtain $(x/c)^2+b(x/c)+c<0$.
By the given information, this is equivalent to $p<x/c<q$.
Multiplication by $c<0$ reverses both inequalities, giving $pc>x>qc$, or $qc<x<pc$.
stepsZh: 再乘以 $c<0$ 时不等号反向，得 $pc>x>qc$，即 $qc<x<pc$。

tmua-2017-p1-q20.summary: Triangle $PQR$ has side lengths $QR=a$, $RP=a+d$, and $PQ=a+2d$, where $a,d>0$ and $3d>2a$. Find the full possible range of $\angle PRQ$.
tmua-2017-p1-q20.summaryZh: 三角形 $PQR$ 的边长依次为 $QR=a$、$RP=a+d$、$PQ=a+2d$，其中 $a,d>0$ 且 $3d>2a$。求 $\angle PRQ$ 的完整取值范围。

methods.title: Use the cosine rule and triangle inequality
methods.titleZh: 利用余弦定理与三角形不等式
steps: Writing $\theta=\angle PRQ$, the cosine rule gives $(a+2d)^2=a^2+(a+d)^2-2a(a+d)\cos\theta$.
Simplification yields $\cos\theta=(a-3d)/(2a)$. Since $3d>2a$, $\cos\theta<-1/2$, so $\theta>120^\circ$.
The triangle inequality $a+2d<a+(a+d)$ gives $d<a$, hence $\cos\theta>-1$ and $\theta<180^\circ$. Both bounds can be approached, so the full range is open at each end.
stepsZh: 三角形不等式 $a+2d<a+(a+d)$ 给出 $d<a$，所以 $\cos\theta>-1$、$\theta<180^\circ$。两个界均可无限逼近，故均为开端点。
